title: Tied notes on tab: a continuation keeps ringing
description: A G chord built over a tied bass, the shape Guitar Pro and Soundslice exports are full of. A tie continuation is still ringing — the string was struck once — so the tab leaves its digit out: the bass G on beat 2 and the D on beat 3 draw nothing, while the notation staff carries the tie arcs. Bars 2–6 repeat an eighth-note figure whose last G is tied into the next bar, so every barline carries a tie: within a system each continuation is silent, and at the line break the continuation that opens the new system is drawn in parentheses, (0), so a line never opens on a silent string. A fresh strike still draws beside a continuation.
